title: Upgrade vsss-rs from 4.3.8 to 5.4.0
description:
Upgrade the `vsss-rs` dependency from 4.3.8 to 5.4.0 (latest published).

## Background

`frozenkrill-core` uses `vsss-rs` for the Pedersen Verifiable Secret Sharing
core that powers the new `split-secret`/`combine-secret` commands. The 5.x
line is a breaking API rewrite — the upgrade isn't just a Cargo.toml bump.

## API changes 4.x → 5.x

| Surface | v4 (current) | v5 (target) |
|---|---|---|
| Share data type | `Vec<u8>` (raw bytes; first byte = share identifier) | `DefaultShare<IdentifierPrimeField<WrappedScalar>, IdentifierPrimeField<WrappedScalar>>` (typed scalar + typed identifier) |
| `StdPedersenResult` type params | `<G, Id, Share>` (3 params) | `<S, V>` (2 params) |
| `pedersen::split_secret` secret arg | by value | by reference (`&S::Value`) |
| `combine_shares` | free function in `vsss_rs::` | now `result.combine()` method on the result |
| Share identifier extraction | `share_bytes[0]` | typed `IdentifierPrimeField<WrappedScalar>` field on the share |
| Verifier set | `vsss_rs::PedersenVerifierSet` trait | `pedersen::Pedersen` re-export + restructured trait surface |

## Files to change

Primary site (only one file in src actually imports vsss-rs):
- `frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs` — touches `vsss_rs::curve25519::{WrappedRistretto, WrappedScalar}`,
  `vsss_rs::pedersen::{StdPedersenResult, split_secret}`, and
  `vsss_rs::{PedersenResult, PedersenVerifierSet, combine_shares}`. Specifically:
  - `split_one_scalar` (the StdPedersenResult call site)
  - `combine_one_half` (the `combine_shares` call site)
  - `verified_unique_share_pairs` (verifier-vec / `verify_share_and_blinder` calls)
  - `parse_ristretto_points` (verifier hex parser)
  - All of the candidate-cross-product enumeration in `combine_vss_wallets`
    that depends on `share_bytes[0]` being the identifier byte
- `frozenkrill-core/Cargo.toml` — `vsss-rs = { version = "5", features = ["curve25519"] }`

## On-disk format implications

Our share files persist `share_data` and `blinder_share_data` as
hex-encoded bytes, currently the raw byte format vsss-rs 4.x emits. v5
serializes typed scalars differently. This is a one-time on-disk format
break — acceptable because the secret-sharing feature has not been
released yet (it's still the open PR #33 against `master`, no users have
committed share files yet).

The `verification_data` (Pedersen verifier set as comma-separated hex of
compressed Ristretto points) MAY be unchanged since Ristretto compression
is a well-established encoding — verify this during the migration rather
than assuming.

## Identifier extraction — careful migration

Several invariants in the codex-hardened combine path key off
`secret_share[0]` being the share identifier byte:
- `verified_unique_share_pairs` dedupe (lines ~556-583)
- The candidate-cross-product enumeration in `combine_vss_wallets` (lines ~882-940)
- HH-2 / II-2 metadata-vote dedupe via 'cryptographic share identifier (first byte of share_data)'

These all need to be rewritten to use v5's typed identifier instead.
The semantics should be preserved (dedupe by share identifier, refuse
ties), but the byte-level access goes away.

## Test surface

The `secret_sharing` test module has 30+ tests covering:
- Round-trip correctness (12-word and 24-word)
- Tampered-share rejection (Pedersen-verification negative cases)
- Per-share verifier corruption tolerance
- Mixed lo/hi verifier corruption (cross-product candidate enumeration)
- Metadata-tamper guards (xpub mismatch, downgrade attacks)
- Duress-mode aggregation
- All of these must continue to pass. Several that currently construct
  `Share` values directly (or compare share_data hex against expected
  byte patterns) may need adaptation to the new types.

## Acceptance criteria

- `vsss-rs = "5"` in `frozenkrill-core/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo build` clean (workspace)
- `cargo test --workspace` green — all existing secret_sharing tests pass
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- --deny warnings` clean
- `cargo fmt --check` clean
- The cryptographic semantics are preserved:
  - Same curve (Curve25519/Ristretto via `vsss_rs::curve25519::WrappedRistretto`/`WrappedScalar`)
  - Same Pedersen blind verification (`g^a · h^b` commitments, `verify_share_and_blinder`-equivalent check)
  - Same threshold-secret-sharing behavior
- The on-disk `share_data`/`blinder_share_data` hex format change is
  documented inline in `secret_sharing.rs` (the format is now version-tied
  to vsss-rs 5.x)
- All codex-hardened invariants still hold (per-share dedupe by
  cryptographic identifier, fail-closed metadata authentication,
  candidate cross-product enumeration for split lo/hi corruption, etc.)

## Out of scope

- Bumping `rand`/`rand_core` to 0.9 — separate concern; vsss-rs 5.x still
  pins `rand_core = "0.6"` on its main branch, so this upgrade doesn't
  unblock the rand bump.
- Bumping `bip39` past `>=0.6, <0.9` cap — same reason.
- Refactoring the surrounding wallet_description / share-encryption /
  CLI code beyond what's necessary to fit the new vsss-rs types.

Source: follow-up to PR #33 cleanup; user asked for the vsss bump after
the codex-review-loop converged on v4.

Migrated frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs to vsss-rs 5.4.0's typed Share/Identifier API; updated Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; added flake.nix packages.default for the nix build gate. Validated: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace (80 passed), nix build. Implemented via ralph-burning iterative_minimal flow (4 rounds; amendments converged 1→1→2→0).
